content.text: {"decision": "insufficient_evidence", "likely_cause": "", "fix": "", "cited_event_ids": ["app:1", "app:2", "app:3", "app:4"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["The windows show a repeated pattern of Sales Invoice (new) to Sales Invoice (list) and back to new in all three sessions, but no event states why the user returned to the list.", "In each session a pointer sample at about x=125, y=100 precedes the list navigation (sessions Sa7681834 and Sf4b4a113 have no tag; Sd046e31e has a span), so the control that triggers the list navigation is not identified by name.", "No event shows whether the new form's data is preserved, reset, or lost after the round trip, so the reason for re-opening the form cannot be determined.", "The list screen shows a coverage overlay (shown then removed) on each visit, but the events do not say what the overlay is or whether it delays the user.", "The insight reports no abandonment and median lost time of 0 s; these figures were taken as given and not verified against the windows.", "Coverage for the insight is empty, and the windows only span 20 s around the start of each session, so later parts of the task are not visible."]}
